newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch KNP BT Q3 profit plunges 67 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dutch KNP BT Q3 profit plunges 67 pct.

text.p: Dutch paper, office supplies and printing equipment group NV Koninklijke KNP BT on Thursday reported a drop in third quarter profits but repeated a forecast for a slight rise in second half net over the first half.

Net profit from ordinary operations in the third quarter dived 67 percent to 38 million guilders ($22.4 million) from a previous 116 million, with nine quarter net from ordinary operations down by a similar margin to 139 million from 394 million.
Analysts had been expecting the company to post a third quarter net from ordinary operations of between 33 million and 45 million guilders.

"Given that the fourth quarter is seasonally the best for KNP BT, we maintain our earlier forecast that the net result over the second half of the year will be slightly higher than in the first half," the company said in a statement.
KNP BT said in July it saw an improved second half. In the first half of 1996, net profits from ordinary operations plunged by 64 percent to 101 million guilders.
The company said its 72-percent owned paper division KNP Leykam made a third quarter operating loss of seven million guilders.
"The sales volumes were good, but the margins remained at a very low level," it said in its results statement.
In the year-earlier quarter KNP Leykam posted an operating profit of 108 million guilders.
KNP said in September it would seek a partner for the troubled division. ($ = 1.695 Dutch Guilders)
